data.name: Moonfire
data.description: You can launch a blast of blazing moonlight from your eyes at a single target within 30 feet as a standard action. Moonfire deals %1d8 points of damage, and the target is dazzled for %2 rounds. This damage is the result of raw divine power, and cannot be blocked by energy resistance. A successful Reflex saving throw (DC %3) reduces the damage by half and negates the dazzle effect. You can use this ability %4 times per day.|DomainDarknessLVL/2|DomainDarknessLVL|DomainDarknessDC|DomainDarknessLVL/4-1
